resolution.question: Brightline ships its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday. Will the CEO post a launch announcement, and at least one of the three design partners publicly repost it, within 24 hours of the ship time?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the CEO posted a launch announcement on social media within 24 hours of the ship time (i.e., between the ship time and 24 hours after), AND at least one of the three design partners publicly reposted that announcement within the same 24-hour window. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff (2026-09-18T09:00:00-07:00).
